fusions.name: Swarming Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Sends a strand that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Diseased], so healing does less for them, for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Cloud on a Cord
fusions.desc: Conjures a trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 14 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Gorge Gained
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
